lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical line segments observed on the primary torso. Spacing is wider at the posterior (rump) and becomes progressively denser/narrower toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A visible Y-shaped bifurcation occurs at the upper-third quadrant of the 5th and 6th lines from the posterior, where they merge near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st posterior line is abbreviated and terminates mid-flank. The 9th and 10th lines are fragmented, with segments terminating before reaching the ventral belly line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower left haunch. Another cluster of 2 spots is visible on the upper hind limb of the right-most subject.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch of the central subject align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white 'stocking' markings on lower limbs; distinct white chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle and white spot on the cheek visible on the central subject.
